readme: Explicit grams (at SOURCE serving count) for lines the parser cannot resolve safely. Key: '<proposed_name>::<canonical item>'. Values: number (r100-compatible) OR object { grams, item?, why }. 'item' remaps the line to a different DB item at OVERRIDE level (canon-mapper bugs like sausages->Italian Seasoning, and title-protein swaps recipes-canon.json still carries from cross-protein sources) - recipes-canon.json is deliberately untouched. Keys of the form '<recipe>::+<Item>' ADD a line the canon lacks (title protein absent from source; missing rice base in a 'rice bowl'). Every entry reviewed by hand against the source recipe's intent; PROTEIN BUMPS beyond source scale are marked [BUMP xN]. R300 build, stage-4 tuning 2026-07-25.
